about: How much of an approved order's line may go on a pick list (3 Nov 2026). A pick list says which products are to go from Hi-Tech's stock now; an order of ten products with five in stock is picked five now and the rest later, on another list. Ordered is counted in the unit Hi-Tech's stock is shown in: whole rolls for tread rubber (custom_rolls), else the line's qty (kg of bonding gum, cans of solution). A line of loose belts only cannot be picked. Remaining is ordered less what earlier Submitted lists hold. The most that may be picked is the smaller of remaining and Hi-Tech's available stock, and nothing at all when either is zero. Implemented in app/lib/core/pick_list.dart (the phone, which makes the lists) and enforced again for ordered/remaining by the manna_pick_list_submit Server Script (app/server/pick_list_submit.py), which also refuses any product not on the order.

cases.why: Tread rubber is picked in whole rolls: 10 ordered, 8 in stock, so at most 8.
Half a roll of belts rides on qty; only the whole rolls are picked.
A line of loose belts only cannot be picked.
Bonding gum is ordered and stocked in kg, so qty is the measure.
What an earlier list took is not offered again: 10 ordered, 6 already picked.
Nothing in Hi-Tech's stock: the product stays on the order but cannot be picked now.
Fully picked already: nothing left, whatever the stock.

kg_about: Kilos on a pick list (5 Nov 2026). SAP counts every line in kilos, and Hi-Tech's pick list, its invoice, Manna Treads' goods receipt and delivery are made from these. Ordered kilos are the line's custom_total_weight, else its qty when the line is counted in kg. Remaining is ordered less the kilos earlier Submitted lists hold. A list may carry no more than what remains (rounded to 3 places): SAP refuses a pick list line released for more than its sales order line has open, so a roll weighed heavier than the order's estimate cannot go over it. A line counted in kg takes its kilos from the picked qty. Implemented in app/lib/core/pick_list.dart and enforced again by manna_pick_list_submit.

kg_cases.why: Rolls are weighed: 10 rolls ordered at 240 kg, nothing picked yet, so up to 240 kg - SAP refuses more than the order line holds.
An earlier list took 150 kg of 240, so 90 remain and at most 90 may go.
Bonding gum is counted in kg: its picked qty is its kilos.
A kg line with no total weight still has its qty as its kilos.
Heavier rolls on earlier lists leave nothing, not a negative.
